3. This petition is filed by the petitioners/accused persons under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing the order sheet and the proceedings in Spl.C.(POCSO) No.52/2023 pending on the file of Additional District and Sessions Judge, FTSC-I, Special(POCSO), Vijayapura for the offence punishable under Sections 376 of IPC, Sections 4 and 6 of POCSO Act and also sections 9, 10, and 11 of Prohibition of Child Marriage Act.

sentences.text: 4. During the pendency of this petition both petitioners and respondent No.3 have appeared through their respective counsel and filed the application under Section 482 read with 320 of Cr.P.C. for seeking permission to compound the offence and consequently quash the criminal proceedings.
The respondent No.2 submits petition may be allowed and the criminal proceedings may be quashed.
Heard the arguments of learned counsel for petitioner and learned HCGP and learned counsel for respondent No.2 6.

The case of the prosecution is that on the information given by the respondent No.3, the Jnanabharathi Police Bangalore registered case in Crime No.109/2023 wherein it is alleged that the accused No.3 said to be married to respondent No.3, when she was minor aged about 17 years and when she had been for pregnancy test, the doctor found she was minor.
An intimation was given to police.
Accordingly, the police obtained information and registered FIR.

Subsequently, on the point of jurisdiction the complaint has been transferred to the Talikot police station, Vijayapura district and the Vijayapura police inturn registered FIR in Crime No.85/2023 for the said offences which is under challenge.
7.

Learned counsel for both parties submit though the offences are non-bailable and non-compoundable, but the accused No.3 and respondent No.3 had migrated to Bangalore from Vijayapura district, while working they married to each other.

When she was pregnant she was taken to the Hospital for pregnancy test and medical test, the police have registered NC:
2023:KHC-K:8670 FIR and now charge sheet has been filed.
Now the victim is already attained age of majority and she has already given birth to a female child and all are residing together.
Though the parents of both sides performed the marriage, without the knowledge of the age of the victim has not attained the age of 18 years.
8. Learned counsel also produced the judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court in SLP No.1890/2023 and the Apex Court also had quashed the criminal proceedings in a similar situation.
The co-ordinate bench also quashed had in the similar case.

Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, when the petitioner married the respondent No.3 and is having child,
though the ignorance of law is not an excuse, but these petitioners who are uneducated people,
without knowledge of the attaining of majority of respondent No.3, she was married and she became Smt Lalbee @ Lalema Sagar vs The State Of Karnataka on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13866864/
4 pregnant.

sentences.text: There is no complaint filed by the complainant or any other person, except the authority who gave the information to the police, when she had come to the pregnancy test.
In the interest of the child and the family life of the accused persons and the respondent no.3, I am of the view, the parties are NC: 2023:KHC-K:8670 allowed to compound the offence.
The petitioner deserves to be allowed.
Accordingly I proceed to pass the following order.
This criminal petition is allowed.

Consequently, proceedings against petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 5 with respect to case in Spl.C.(POCSO) No.52/2023 pending on the file of Additional District and Sessions Judge, FTSC-I,
Special(POCSO), Vijayapura, is hereby quashed.
